page.overview:
What is Ivalice?

Ivalice in Final Fantasy Tactics Advance is a dream world and country populated by five races. Situated in a peninsula that stretches southwards, its geography varies from deserts to snowy mountains to lush green plains. The kingdom is governed by a set of laws created using magic by its ancient king and enforced by a rank of Judges.

The geography of Ivalice revolves around plains, mountains, deserts, forests, and swamps, and introduces areas called jagds; lawless slums where no Judges dare to tread. Jagds are the only places where a character can die; everywhere else, they are protected from death by the Judges and are simply knocked out.

The placement of location symbols on the world map after each story-related mission and certain other missions is controlled completely by the player, and there are potentially thousands of world map configurations varying by player. The "Treasure Hunting" system is deeply linked to location placement, and can sometimes result in items that cannot be found any other way (note: Four locations in the game always have default placement - Giza Plains, Cyril, Bervenia Palace, and Ambervale).

There is a calendar system that advances one day for every step taken on the World Map. There are 5 months, and each month has 20 days in it. Each month is also representative of one of the races of Ivalice. If the number of units in the Clan decreases to 5 or less, a mission will become available in the Pub that allows one to recruit a new unit, whose race depends on the current month.
